text.en: A great teacher who opened the temple of knowledge to all.

Peruvazhi is a drama in the textbook about Ramanujar, a saint who taught equality and brotherhood. A drama tells its story through dialogue and action, so read it with attention to the characters.
The play brings out the message of equality and compassion in religion. Read the play in your textbook for its scenes and lines.
Terms: நாடகம் (drama), உரையாடல் (dialogue), இராமானுசர் and சமத்துவம் (equality).
